published_statement: Carroll (restating Einstein 1915): 'we can present Einstein's equations for general relativity: R_munu - (1/2) R g_munu = 8 pi G T_munu (4.52)'; contracting in four dimensions gives R = -kappa T and 'R_munu = kappa (T_munu - (1/2) T g_munu) (4.45) ... the same equation'; 'Even in vacuum, where we set the energy-momentum tensor to zero, the resulting equations R_munu = 0 (4.53)'. With a cosmological constant: 'G_munu = 8 pi G T_munu - Lambda g_munu (8.29) ... the same form as the equations with no cosmological constant but an energy-momentum tensor for the vacuum T(vac)_munu = -(Lambda/8 pi G) g_munu (8.30)'.
published_hypotheses: four spacetime dimensions (the trace step R = -kappa T, eq. 4.44, is stated 'in four dimensions')
metric-compatible, torsion-free (Christoffel/Levi-Civita) connection; curvature built from g and its first and second derivatives
T_munu symmetric and covariantly conserved, nabla_mu T^munu = 0 (eq. 4.38; guaranteed by diffeomorphism invariance of S_M, eq. 5.38)
field equation second order in the metric and linear in second derivatives (the Einstein tensor is the conserved symmetric (0,2) tensor so built; Hilbert action is the unique such scalar, p.114)
coefficient kappa = 8 pi G fixed by the weak-field, static, slow-motion (Newtonian) limit, eq. (4.51)
no cosmological constant in the 1915 form; Lambda enters only as the modification (4.74)/(8.29), equivalently as a vacuum T = -(Lambda/8 pi G) g

T_munu is the matter stress-energy defined by the matter action (4.70); if T is instead defined as G/8 pi G then 'any metric at all' solves the equations (p.117) and physical content comes only from conditions imposed on T (e.g. WEC, 4.72)
classical: T is a classical tensor (a semiclassical G = 8 pi <T> is a further hypothesis not in the source)

lacked_data: M's hypothesis tested: the 1915 authors lacked (a) the measurement of cosmic acceleration (1998) and hence of Lambda, (b) strong-field and radiative tests (binary pulsars from 1974, gravitational waves from 2015), (c) a precise G. Evidence AGAINST the hypothesis changing the conclusion: every test read (Will 2014 Table 4; GWTC-5.0, 168 events) is consistent with G = 8 pi G T; G is unchanged 2018 -> 2022; c is exact. Evidence FOR a change: exactly one datum moved -- Lambda went from absent to 1.089e-52 m^-2. It does not refute the 1915 equation (Lambda can be written as a vacuum T, Carroll eq. 8.30) and moves no computed number in the tree by more than ~1e-26 relative (C8c), and nothing null-contracted at all (C5). But it makes Lambda = 0 a genuine hypothesis wherever T is read as matter, and no owner names it: tolman THEOREM X's 'Minkowski' is 'de Sitter' in that reading (C8a). So the lacked datum NARROWS the statements the tree draws from the equation when T is matter, and changes nothing where T := G/8pi. Not presumed either way: shown by C5, C8a-c.
grade_evidence: The equation STANDS as a law: restated exactly at source (Carroll 4.43-4.53), every identity the 12 owners use re-derived by sympy (24/24: trace reversal, Misner-Sharp dm/dr = 4 pi r^2 rho, contracted Bianchi, axial V2, R_kk = 8 pi T_kk, q = (4 pi G/c^4) T_kk, T_COEFF, foliation's Ricci-flatness), no experimental deviation in Will 2014 or GWTC-5.0, G unmoved (CODATA 2022 = 2018). The grade is NARROWED, not STANDS, for one reason, shown and not presumed: the tree uses the Lambda = 0 form without naming Lambda = 0 in any owner (grep: 'cosmological' absent from all 12), while the measured Lambda = 1.089e-52 m^-2 (Planck 2018) makes that a real hypothesis for the owners that read T as matter -- tolman THEOREM X (conclusion becomes de Sitter, C8a), overturn L2 (m' gains Lambda r^2/2, C8b), foliation (Ricci-flat is not T^matter = 0), candidates. Scope of the narrowing, stated so it is not over-represented: it moves no computed figure by more than ~1e-26 relative, it is exactly empty for every null-contracted result (seatindex, anec, anecscope), and it is empty for every owner that defines T := G/8pi (nonstatic, formation, specthm D4/R1/R2, axial, certify). The seatindex '9.5054e43' is a rounding discrepancy (true 9.505325e43), not an error; certify's two unit conventions never meet in arithmetic.
what_would_change_the_grade: To STANDS: the owners that read T as matter (tolman.py THEOREM X, overturn.py L2, foliation.py vacuum lines, candidates.py) name 'Lambda = 0, or Lambda absorbed into T' as a hypothesis -- the equation and every identity already agree. To DATA-DEPENDENT: a result in the tree whose verdict depends on the magnitude of rho_Lambda (none found; the only scale where it competes with the seatindex threshold is l ~ 4.3e26 m, and there it still contributes 0 to T_kk). To WRONG: a measured deviation from G = 8 pi G T in a regime the tree uses (none in Will 2014 or GWTC-5.0), or a sympy contradiction in C1-C10 (none).
